  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.leads` AS l
  JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.campaigns` AS c

converted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sl.lead_id

  COUNTIF(c.lead_id IS NOT NULL) AS converted_within_30_days,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(c.lead_id IS NOT NULL), COUNT(*)) AS win_rate
FROM search_leads AS sl
LEFT JOIN converted AS c ON c.lead_id = sl.lead_id

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_cancelled_revenue,
  SUM(amount) AS gross_amount,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers_all,

    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
cust AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.customers`
)
SELECT
  c.country,
  SUM(o.amount) AS revenue_eur,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buying_customers,
  SUM(o.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS revenue_per_buying_customer_eur
FROM orders_sept o
JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

ORDER BY revenue_per_buying_customer_eur DESC
